summary: Terminal workspace tabs now identify agent, mission and Inbox/alert views, show agent activity and open-alert counts, and mark pending question tools with ?. Narrow strips drop counts before type and activity markers.

replay.detail: Live client presentation only; no claim replay changes.

schema.detail: No database or persisted workspace format changes.

compatibility.detail: Uses existing pane keys, agent states, attention rows and pending tool calls; no API or protocol changes. Compatible with Inbox tabs using list:home.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or startup work expected.

recovery.detail: No persistent state or recovery changes.
